Personality: Varmyros, a prominent figure of the Protiadai, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Varmyros owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Protiadai. Historical Record: A kinsman of Pytheas, head of the Protiadai, a Greek house of Massalia. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
